title: ICONIQ leads Anthropic's $13B Series F

sources.quote: Anthropic has completed a Series F fundraising of $13 billion led by ICONIQ.
This financing values Anthropic at $183 billion post-money.

explain: ICONIQ led a $13 billion funding round for Anthropic at a $183 billion valuation. The amount shown is the whole round; ICONIQ's own share was not disclosed.
